'''Desilijic Estate Towers''' was a location on the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. During [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] leadership of the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Kajidic/Legends|Kajidic]], the Towers were one of the Kajidic's primary bases of operation.<ref name="LoNH" />
